items.name: Defrex Hide
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

Made from the hide of a ferocious mammal native to Vesk-2, this medium armor is especially popular among vesk. Tanned slabs of the creature's thick hide are stitched together with metal wires, and the joints are reinforced with metal studs or scales.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Black Hole
offensiveAbilities.description:
The degradant deals 9d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage to each enemy creature within 30 feet with a DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save. The degradant can't use Black Hole again for 1d4 rounds.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is pulled 5 feet toward the degradant.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is pulled 10 feet toward the degradant.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is pulled 30 feet toward the degradant, and is knocked Prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Crush
offensiveAbilities.description: The degradant uses gravity to crush an enemy within 100 feet, dealing 4d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save); on a critical failure, the creature takes an additional 1d6 Persistent,bleed Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Graviton Glaive
offensiveAbilities.description: A degradant wields a solar glaive formed of solidified gravitons. They can conjure and dismiss this weapon as a single action that has the concentrate trait. Whenever they successfully Strike a creature using their graviton glaive, the creature treats all squares adjacent to the square in which it was struck as difficult terrain until the end of the creature's next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Stellar Rush
offensiveAbilities.description: The degradant Strides twice, gaining a +10-foot circumstance bonus to their Speed during these moves. When they complete these Strides, all enemies within 15 feet of the degradant are pulled 15 feet closer to the degradant unless they succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save.
